notes.title: SUPER DRAGON BALL HEROES WORLD MISSION Update Ver.1.01.02
notes.content:
Attention, heroes!
A new patch is available now for [b]SUPER DRAGON BALL HEROES WORLD[/b] MISSION. 
Ver.1.01.02 fixes the following issues:

[list]
[*] Fixed the issue from the recent free update, where the game freezes if the players creates a custom card using the newly added customization contents from the last update, proceeds to edit a mission in Mission Edit mode, and attempts to start this mission.
[*] Fixed an issue where the game freezes during the Deck Selection screen, if a card is equipped with (Limitless Saiyan) ability and equipped with a specific accessory.
[*] Fixed an issue that occurs in Story Mode Chapter 4-1, and Chapter 4-4, when the player separates with their allies.
[*] Fixed an issue that occurs when players purchase (Blank Cards) in the Creation Shop.
[*] Fixed an issue concerning player Titles in the (S+ Top Ranking) screen in Ranked Matches mode.
[*] Fixed an issue where the player was unable to move the Cards in the Unit Set screen, when cancelling the (Fuse) action during battle.
[/list]

Thank you for your constant support on SUPER DRAGON BALL HEROES WORLD MISSION.

notes.title: A patch, a free udpate and a demo release today for Super Dagon Ball Heroes World Mission
notes.content:
All things come in threes!
We are happy to announce the Demo for SUPER DRAGON BALL HEROES WORLD MISSION. In addition to this, we are also revealing the content of today’s free update and patch.
Watch the trailer for a recap of the free update.
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34784643/2887d25f28bea431aab49142437f2e037ec5b365.jpg[/img]https://youtu.be/85-6QX3EU0w
You can read the article on http://bnent.eu/SDBHpatchUpdate for an extensive list of the Free Update content and for the patch note.

The patch 1.01.01 fixes the following issues:
[list]
[*] Game crashes when starting a tournament in Hero Stadium with Dark Demon God as an avatar, in God Class Up or Super God Class Up.
[*] Trunks navigation voice disappears during the battle after playing mini game “Charge Impact” in the Hero Lab.
[*] When attempting an online battle while Trunks voice has disappeared, the game gets stuck when Pursuit chance appears.
[*] Reward conditions in Creation Mode do not work properly.
[*] Unlimited rewards glitch in the Creation Mode
[/list]
Thanks for playing [b]SUPER DRAGON BALL HEROES WORLD MISSION[/b]
